The chancellor held that alimony and child-support allowances must be determined from the particular circumstances of each case, without a fixed general rule. The defendant’s estate should be valued when the master reports, rather than when the bill is filed, and the allowance should not be based solely on current rents and profits or the complainant’s actual needs. Children should be maintained in a manner corresponding to their father’s condition, without imposing a pecuniary burden on the mother.

After the master recommended annual allowances of $390 for the wife and $482 for three children, additional evidence showed reduced property values, greater debts, and a homestead unavailable to the defendant because of his mother’s life interest. The court therefore reduced the award to $250 annually for the wife and $130 annually for each child, totaling $640 payable semiannually.

The decree required reasonable security for payment. On default, the wife could seek sequestration and appointment of a receiver, or other equitable process; the statute was held not to limit enforcement to sequestration alone. The decree also made the award a lien on the defendant’s New Jersey property, awarded the wife her costs, and allowed either party to seek modification if circumstances changed.

Veterans who helped clean up Enewetak Atoll after U.S. nuclear testing warn that the deteriorating concrete dome containing radioactive waste is allowing radiation to enter the Pacific Ocean. More than 8,000 workers shifted 110,000 cubic yards of contaminated material into a 30-foot-deep crater on Runit Island before it was covered by the dome. Cleanup participants reported inadequate protective equipment, seawater moving through the porous, fractured crater, and health problems they attribute to radiation. Of 8,033 mission participants, only 600 have been accounted for, and 35 are reported deceased. Dome draughtsman Girard Frank Bolton III said radiation was washing into the lagoon and ocean because the structure was designed to slow, not stop, its escape. Experts said the danger depends on how much radioactivity is released and whether it reaches food or water; the principal health risk is increased lifetime cancer risk, though individual cases cannot be linked definitively to exposure. Veterans are seeking U.S. government assistance for radiation-related health issues.

The lecture reviews the theorem of irrelevance in detection theory. A transmitted signal occupies a finite set of degrees of freedom, while the received waveform contains additional, independent components. These components may include noise, other users’ signals, or signals sent at other times, but they can be ignored without affecting detection. For a white Gaussian noise channel, all modulation systems therefore have the same basic noise performance; their practical differences concern carrier recovery, synchronization, filtering, and passband-to-baseband conversion. The problem can be treated as a finite-dimensional vector problem.

For a batch of independent transmitted signals, signal-by-signal maximum-likelihood detection gives the same decisions as joint detection of the complete sequence because the likelihood ratio factors. If the inputs are dependent, as with error-corrected data, joint detection uses information unavailable to separate symbol decisions and can achieve a lower error probability. Consequently, separate detection followed by error correction is suboptimal, and coding systems that use the full observation—such as probabilistic decoding techniques—can perform better.

The lecture then examines orthogonal, simplex, and biorthogonal signal sets. For two dimensions, a 45-degree rotation of a biorthogonal set produces a standard 4QAM constellation with orthogonal noise components, making error probabilities easy to calculate. With three or more dimensions, decision regions are no longer mutually orthogonal and exact error analysis becomes substantially harder. Scaled orthogonal and simplex codes have the same error probability, but simplex codes save energy because removing the mean eliminates one degree of freedom; the energy difference is \(1-1/m\). Orthogonal codes nevertheless can simplify frequency and phase locking. Orthogonal and biorthogonal sets use the same average energy, while biorthogonal signaling roughly doubles the number of equally likely error events.

An error bound for a large orthogonal code is developed using Gaussian noise normalization, conditioning on the received component in the transmitted signal’s direction, and the union bound. This demonstrates that error probability can decrease exponentially with the number of encoded bits. At \(E_b/N_0=\ln 2\), corresponding to \(E_b=N_0\ln 2\) in this setting, the error probability vanishes as the code size grows; this is presented as the essence of the white Gaussian noise channel-capacity result.

The lecture then turns to wireless communication, which differs from wired communication through radiation between antennas, time-varying channels, fading, attenuation, filtering, interference, and multiple transmitters and receivers. Wireless systems offer mobility and avoid wired-network constraints, but reliability and capacity remain limited.

Cellular networks are presented as appendages to wired telephone networks. Mobile phones communicate with base stations, which connect through switching centers to the wired network. Base-station placement is a difficult electromagnetic and physical modeling problem, while mobile and base-station design depend mainly on coarse channel characteristics. Other organizational problems include selecting an available base station, locating an active mobile, and routing calls when the mobile is far from its usual area.

The reverse link, from mobiles to a base station, is a multiple-access channel because many users’ waveforms randomly combine. The forward link, from a base station to mobiles, is a broadcast channel that sends different messages to different users while trying to keep them separate. Voice has strict delay requirements, whereas data can tolerate more delay and permit different transmission techniques.

Finally, the lecture outlines physical modeling questions for wireless systems, including bandwidth, carrier frequency, Doppler shift, attenuation, filtering, and channel variation over time and frequency. It distinguishes narrowband systems from wideband systems, whose bandwidth is a significant fraction of the carrier frequency or uses carrier-free waveforms. The next discussion will address how rapidly channels change, how frequency separation produces effectively independent channels, and idealized models involving direct radiation and reflection.

Microsoft Corporation’s October 26, 2015 Form 8-K recasts financial information for the three years ended June 30, 2015 to reflect fiscal 2016 segment-reporting changes. The new segments are Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing, with operating income used to assess segment profitability. Recast information appears in Exhibits 99.1–99.3; it does not amend or restate the audited 2015 Form 10-K financial statements or otherwise update its disclosures.

England’s maintained nursery heads warned that funding cuts could force hundreds of schools to close, with supplementary government funding of £60 million annually due only through 2019–20 and no guarantee thereafter. Headteachers said repeated budget reductions and rising business rates, wage, pension and special-needs costs had led to staff cuts and wider roles for some leaders. About 400 council-funded nurseries remain open, providing 30,000 places, with more than 60% in deprived areas. Ministers urged councils not to close nurseries prematurely, while Conservative MPs called for funding certainty and warned that disabled children and those with medical needs could suffer if funding ended.

The author argues that Exxon Mobil is an attractive contrarian buy amid long-term uncertainty in energy. XOM trades near its summer 2015 lows, offers a 4.1% dividend yield, and has grown annual cash flow by 20%, supporting potential share repurchases. Its price-to-cash-flow valuation is near a five-year low.

The author believes recent stabilization in crude oil and natural gas suggests the broader decline in WTI prices since 2008 may be ending. XOM could benefit from renewed energy-sector momentum, particularly given its strong performance during the prior oil-and-gas downturn and expectations of doubled earnings by 2025. The stock trades below 16 times forward earnings, while the author sees limited downside risk and expects another dividend increase in April.

Technically, XOM is near support around $71.60, a double-bottom and head-and-shoulders neckline. The author expects buy orders near this level and anticipates possible bull rallies during the first half of the year, with a long-term price range of $56.50 to $103.80. The author discloses being long XOM.

Stefon Diggs had 10 catches for 146 yards in New England’s Sunday Night Football win over his former team, the Bills, while expressing support for quarterback Josh Allen. His performance matched Julian Edelman’s Patriots record for consecutive 100-yard receiving games, and his 61 yards after the catch were his highest since 2022. Diggs joined the Patriots after a season-ending knee injury cut his 2024 stint with Buffalo short.

The disclosure describes a display apparatus with a thin, flexible vibration module attached to the rear surface of a display panel. The module vibrates the panel to produce sound or haptic feedback while addressing the space, thickness, impact-damage, and sound-performance limitations of conventional speakers and piezoelectric elements.

The module includes a piezoelectric composite layer with alternating first and second portions. The first portions contain inorganic piezoelectric ceramic and provide vibration, while flexible organic or polymer second portions fill the spaces between them, absorb impacts, distribute stress, and enable bending. Electrode layers are formed on both surfaces of the composite layer, receive electrical signals, and may be covered by protection films. The composite is polarized by applying voltage in a controlled temperature atmosphere.

Embodiments vary the size, spacing, and shape of the composite portions—including line, circular, dotted, and triangular patterns—to adjust flexibility, panel coverage, sound-pressure characteristics, and high-, middle-, and low-frequency reproduction. A stacked bimorph embodiment uses two piezoelectric composite layers with intervening insulation and electrodes to increase vibration force and sound pressure.

Another embodiment places separate vibration modules in left and right panel regions. Partition members and enclosed air gaps separate their vibrations, reduce interference and sound leakage, and support two-channel stereo output. The disclosed apparatus may be used in curved, rollable, bendable, flexible, and wearable displays.

TopoSPAM is a unified framework for multiscale biological simulations. It supports intracellular models of polar fluids, gels, and nematic liquid crystals in active and passive forms, as well as tissue-scale simulations using a quasi-3D active vertex model on curved surfaces and coarse-grained 3D models of viscoelastic, spontaneous-strain-driven morphogenesis. Its architecture enables high-performance computing and interactive visualization.

Mega Geometry’s GPU-driven cluster generation and rapid BVH construction allow subdivision-surface tessellation to map directly to clusters, enabling fast ray tracing as animations or viewpoints change.

Oklahoma’s Medicaid program will soon be the first to negotiate drugmaker rebates for medicines that fail as claimed. Federal approval lets manufacturers potentially cover resulting costs, such as hospitalizations. Participation is voluntary; OHCA is negotiating with 20 companies, 10 of which are actively discussing terms.

Kalidou Koulibaly scored a stoppage-time header as Napoli beat Juventus 1-0 in Turin, cutting the Serie A leaders’ advantage to one point with four games remaining. The result kept Napoli’s hopes of a first title since 1989-90 alive and left Massimiliano Allegri’s side with an arguably tougher run-in, including matches against Inter and Roma. Juventus lost Giorgio Chiellini to injury, while Napoli made two second-half substitutions. Zielinski and Callejon tested Buffon before Koulibaly rose to head the decisive goal from a corner.

Some Prince Edward Island schools require parents to buy supplies, while others provide supplies for a flat fee capped at $40. Cornwall parent Jerica Devos has spent about $70 on supplies for her six-year-old son and questions why costs vary between schools. Provincial guidelines let schools adjust quantities, colours and brands on a master supply list but not add items. Parents can opt out of flat fees and purchase supplies themselves, but schools without flat-fee options offer no alternative. Public Schools Branch director Parker Grimmer welcomed feedback and encouraged concerned parents to contact their school or the branch.

The bullish engulfing pattern is a two-candlestick bullish reversal pattern formed after a downward swing: a small bearish candlestick is completely engulfed by a larger bullish candlestick, indicating a shift from bearish to bullish momentum and a potential upward reversal. It often appears near support levels and is considered more reliable after a significant 61.8% Fibonacci pullback in an uptrend.

A potential trade setup should be assessed alongside market conditions, support and resistance, volume, and confirmation such as a follow-through day or another bullish pattern. Trading plans should define entry and exit criteria, including profit targets, stop losses, handling profitable trades, and cutting losses. Historical data can be used to backtest the strategy by identifying patterns, establishing rules, simulating trades, and evaluating performance. The passage also identifies benefits including reversal signals, trend-change confirmation, identifying key levels, risk management, and a high probability of success.

YourEnergySource invested in CheMatch.com and formed a strategic alliance with it; 3Com Ventures took an undisclosed stake in HealtheTech.

Business developments included the launch of BiblioMondo.com, Telaric’s planned incubator-services launch, and a strategic alliance between BT Brightstar and incuVest. Numerous boards and executive teams changed. AirMedia, Plural, Moai Technologies, TeraLogic, AgWeb, Lightspeed Interactive, Buyproduce, Go4Equity, and eLaw.com announced new CEOs, while nine companies reported board appointments. Disability research found that only eight of Scotland’s 32 councils are expected to meet the government-recommended October deadline for ensuring equal treatment of disabled taxi passengers. Perth and Kinross is the only council to have completed a Section 167 list of wheelchair-accessible taxis; seven others plan to meet the deadline, while 18 have no plans or are undecided. An April Equality Act change allows fines of up to £1,000 for registered drivers who refuse wheelchair users or charge extra, but its reach is limited by incomplete lists. Across England, Scotland and Wales, just 11% of councils had created such lists and 30% intended to do so. Doug Paulley and Muscular Dystrophy UK called on councils to create lists urgently and the government to enforce their responsibilities.

On March 21, 2018, Tesla reported that stockholders at a special meeting approved Elon Musk’s performance-based stock option award, granted January 21, 2018. The award met majority-vote requirements under NASDAQ rules, Tesla’s bylaws, and a disinterested-shareholder standard. Votes were 96,795,092 for and 23,407,632 against, with 173,167 abstentions; 63,014,339 disinterested shares voted for. The award’s terms were incorporated from Tesla’s February 8 proxy statement, filed as Exhibit 99.1.

A prospective cohort study at Johns Hopkins Hospital enrolled adults with RT-PCR-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection between April 2020 and September 2021; 264 of 723 participants underwent standardized lung ultrasound. Six-second recordings from 12 lung zones were reviewed for A lines, B lines, consolidations, pleural effusions, and pleural-line abnormalities. A mean lung ultrasound score (mLUSS), ranging from 0 to 3 and calculated using available zones, was evaluated for progression to ICU-level care, 28-day mortality, and ventilation or death.

Baseline ultrasound abnormalities generally increased with clinical severity. Inter-reader mLUSS correlation was 0.77 among 61 participants. Among 164 patients requiring no more than low-flow oxygen at baseline, each one-point mLUSS increase was associated with progression to ICU-level care (adjusted hazard ratio 3.61, 95% CI 1.27–10.22). Across all severity groups, each point increase was associated with 28-day mortality (adjusted hazard ratio 3.10, 95% CI 1.29–7.50), but the association with the composite of ventilation or death was not statistically significant. Results were unchanged in sensitivity analyses and after adjustment for symptom duration.

Higher proportions of A lines were associated with lower risks of ICU-level care and mortality, while B lines, pleural abnormalities, consolidations, and effusions generally showed associations with adverse outcomes, though not always statistical significance. Pleural abnormalities were particularly associated with mechanical ventilation or death and with death alone.

The findings indicate that individual lung ultrasound findings and mLUSS may help identify hospitalized COVID-19 patients likely to require increased oxygen support or higher-level care. The study was limited by its single-center hospital-based convenience sample, variable timing of enrollment, small subgroups with wide confidence intervals, and inability to assess longitudinal changes in ultrasound findings.

On December 14, 2000, Todd Kimberlain forwarded to V. Charles Weldon data supplied by Jack Beven and Jim Gross of the National Hurricane Center. Gross reported finding a file of U.S. watch and warning areas from 1963–1998, constructed by Mark Demaria and assumed complete for the continental United States. Records contain the month, day, year, hour, storm name, number of warnings, storm ID, and affected location pairs; the direction of each pair is arbitrary. Warning codes are: 6—hurricane warning, 5—hurricane watch, 4—storm warning, 3—gale warning, 2—tropical storm warning, and 1—tropical storm watch. The data begins with Cindy in September 1963 and concludes with Mitch on November 5, 1998.

An international study involving UCL researchers found that newly established alien species increased continuously worldwide over the past 200 years, with no overall sign of saturation. Using more than 45,000 first-detection records for over 16,000 species, the team found 37% were introduced from 1970–2014, peaking at 585 new species in 1996. Trends varied by taxonomic group, reflecting horticulture, colonial-era introductions, and post-1950 globalization. The authors warned that existing prevention efforts have not kept pace and called for more effective policies to limit ecosystem homogenization and native-species extinctions.

A researcher cited on NPR said that after losing 5% of body weight, a person may need 10% fewer calories to maintain that weight loss, potentially explaining why weight is regained. This week’s “Disasters Averted” discusses keeping weight off. The new dMeetings program lets diabetes patients learn at their own pace from certified educators.

A Providence community health system study evaluated pathologist-directed comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) for 3,216 patients with advanced solid cancers tested from September 2019 through November 2021. Using a standardized 523-gene DNA/RNA assay at no patient cost, testing began at diagnosis, with a median turnaround time of 14 days and results available a median 12 days before the initial oncologist visit.

Forty-nine percent of patients had at least one guideline-based actionable biomarker; high tumor mutational burden was most common, followed by BRAF and EGFR alterations. Comprehensive profiling identified substantially more opportunities for targeted therapy and clinical trials than a legacy 50-gene panel: 53% matched an ASCO-TAPUR, NCI-MATCH, or MyPathway basket-trial arm versus 26% with the smaller panel, and 67% versus 33% had guideline-based or trial-matching actionable alterations.

Among 1,482 patients with documented follow-up and treatment, 54% with an appropriate immunotherapy biomarker received immunotherapy with or without chemotherapy, while 32% received chemotherapy alone. Overall, median survival was 25 months for targeted therapy versus 17 months for chemotherapy alone; targeted therapy was associated with better survival after adjustment for age and tumor type (HR 0.66, p<0.001). In non-small-cell lung cancer, median survival was 26 versus 16 months, with an adjusted HR of 0.55 (p=0.032).

The authors identified remaining barriers, including non-actionable genomic findings, physician hesitancy, cost and insurance coverage, unequal treatment access, acquired resistance, and the need for improved physician education and alternative therapies. They also anticipated future use of broader panels or whole-genome sequencing as new targets emerge and sequencing costs decline.

The $120-off SteamOS-equipped Lenovo Legion Go S is a capable, comfortable handheld for travelers, couch gamers, and Steam Deck upgraders. Its bulky grips, spacious controls, bright 120-Hz IPS screen, 1 TB storage, 32 GB memory, and MicroSD slot make it practical, though some games may require settings tweaks. The reviewer prefers its straightforward SteamOS setup and performance over the Windows model and an aging Steam Deck; the newer Legion 2 is larger, costlier, and ships with Windows.

Mercedes-Benz introduced a limited GLS “Grand Edition” amid rivalry from Range Rover, Volvo and BMW’s incoming X7. It features 20-inch lightweight wheels, unique badges, nappa leather, wood trim, quilted brown seats and velour floor mats. The €8,250 package is optional on non-AMG GLS variants, with deliveries beginning March 2018.

George Washington declared that conciliation had failed to restore obedience to federal law in western Pennsylvania and that militia from four states were moving to the affected area. He assured citizens of government protection, offered renewed leniency to compliant offenders, and urged all citizens and officers to oppose the insurgents and uphold the Constitution and laws.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K on April 26, 2022, announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2022. The filing includes the April 26 press release as Exhibit 99.1 and an embedded cover page interactive data file.

Russian journalist Arkady Babchenko appeared alive at a Kyiv news conference after Ukrainian authorities said his reported shooting was staged to prevent an assassination plot. Investigators said a Ukrainian recruited and paid $40,000 by Russian security services hired a former separatist fighter to shoot him.
