The Supreme Court denied review in numerous cases, including Ghislaine Maxwell’s challenge to her prosecution, a Second Amendment gun-law challenge, a police-dog drug-sniffing case, and Laura Loomer’s social media censorship suit. It also denied rehearing in a Native American challenge to the transfer of sacred land in an Arizona national forest; Justice Neil Gorsuch said he would have granted rehearing. No cases were added to the court’s 2025–26 docket. The justices requested the solicitor general’s views on nuclear-safety regulations, trademark strength, and arbitration under the Foreign Sovereign Immunities Act. Justice Samuel Alito recused himself from the Loomer case and did not participate in the sacred-land decision.

Richard Dennis and William Eckhardt developed Turtle Trading through a 1983 experiment testing whether trading could be taught. Dennis recruited and trained 14 novice traders, funded them with $500,000–$2 million, and many succeeded when they followed his rules strictly, although some struggled or left the experiment.

The strategy is a mechanical trend-following system. Turtles entered long positions on breakouts such as a 20-day high, added to winners as later breakouts occurred, and exited or reversed after an opposing breakout. Its three central rules were volatility-based position sizing using ATR, pyramiding to increase profitable positions, and predetermined stop-loss and exit orders. The original markets included bonds, commodities, stock-index futures, and currencies.

The experiment demonstrated that trading skills could be learned and influenced many successful trading firms. Dennis lost more than half his assets in 1987–1988 and stopped trading, while Eckhardt later acknowledged the mechanical program’s success and founded a profitable CTA.

Turtle Trading remains relevant, particularly in markets with clear trends, though traders often add technical indicators for trend identification. Its results have generally been less profitable than in the 1980s. Trend-following systems also experience frequent whipsaws, low win rates, long drawdowns, and profits concentrated in relatively short periods. Backtests discussed include momentum, dual-moving-average, ATR-channel, and Bollinger-band breakouts. Crypto strategies performed well through 2022, but weakening crypto trends have made them harder to trade.

The ADS868xW is a fully integrated, 16-bit successive-approximation data-acquisition device with an integrated analog front end, programmable gain amplifier, ADC driver, precision reference, and reference buffer. It supports single-ended and differential, bipolar and unipolar input ranges and uses straight-binary output formatting. A second-order antialiasing low-pass filter at the PGA output, typically set to a 500 kHz −3 dB cutoff, reduces front-end amplifier and PGA-resistor noise.

The device supports internal or external voltage references selected through INTREF_DIS. The internal reference has a nominal 4.096 V output, requires at least 4.7 µF of REFIO decoupling, and should not directly drive external loads. It is factory trimmed but can shift due to mechanical or thermal stress, particularly during PCB solder-reflow operations. Temperature compensation is provided over −40°C to +125°C. External-reference mode accepts a 4.096 V source at REFIO; the internal buffer drives REFCAP, which requires at least 10 µF of decoupling plus a nearby 1 µF capacitor. The buffer’s specified temperature drift is 0.5 ppm/°C typical and 2 ppm/°C maximum.

The full-scale range equals the positive full-scale voltage minus the negative full-scale voltage, and the ADC LSB size is FSR/2^16. Alarm functionality provides an active-high output for programmable input-voltage thresholds with common hysteresis and fixed AVDD thresholds of 4.7 V and 5.3 V. Input and AVDD alarms each have active and tripped flags. Active flags clear at the end of a conversion, while tripped flags clear when ALARM_REG is read. Alarm status can be accessed through the ALARM pin, ALARM_REG, or appended to output data.

The multiSPI interface supports standard SPI modes, single- or dual-SDO data output, and source-synchronous operation with internal or external clock selection. Single-device and daisy-chain topologies are supported. In a daisy chain, devices must be configured identically; an optimal frame for N devices contains 32×N SCLK capture edges, and data is returned from device N backward to device 1.

The device operates in RESET, ACQ, and CONV states. The active-low RST input can perform either an application reset or a full power-on reset according to RSTn_APP. A conversion begins on the rising edge of CONVST/CS and ends in ACQ, with completion indicated by RVS or by waiting for the maximum conversion time.

Data-transfer frames begin when CONVST/CS is pulled low and end on its next rising edge. A 32-clock frame is optimal for valid commands; short frames permit reads but invalidate writes, while long frames use the final 32 bits as the command. Register writes require 32-bit commands, and half-word commands operate on 16 bits with the address LSB ignored. Output normally contains the latest conversion result, or register data following a read command. Configurable output flags can append device address, input range, AVDD alarm, input alarm, and parity information.

Nine 32-bit-mapped configuration registers are described: DEVICE_ID_REG, RST_PWRCTL_REG, SDI_CTL_REG, SDO_CTL_REG, DATAOUT_CTL_REG, RANGE_SEL_REG, ALARM_REG, ALARM_H_TH_REG, and ALARM_L_TH_REG. Writes to RST_PWRCTL_REG require first writing the 0x69 protection key to address 0x05.

An industrial input-module example combines an ADS8681W with a MUX36D08 differential multiplexer to provide eight configurable voltage or current channels. It supports standard industrial ranges including ±10 V, 0–10 V, and 4–20 mA. The ADS8681W settles to 1% accuracy in under 5 µs and includes input-range, input-alarm, and AVDD-alarm functions. A thermistor example demonstrates using programmable input-alarm thresholds and hysteresis for temperature monitoring.

The device uses separate analog and digital supplies, AVDD and DVDD. Supply decoupling requires close-placed 1 µF capacitors and at least 10 µF bulk capacitance, with improved power-supply rejection when properly decoupled. Programmable NAP mode reduces consumption between conversions, while power-down mode shuts down analog blocks but retains the interface and registers.

PCB guidance calls for separating analog and digital routing, using short ground paths, avoiding vias between supply or reference pins and their bypass capacitors, placing 1 µF and 10 µF capacitors at REFCAP, and decoupling REFIO with at least 4.7 µF when using the internal reference. The document also includes ESD precautions, support resources, packaging information, and revision history noting that ADS8685W and ADS8689W changed from advance information to production status.

BC Coroners Service data recorded 1,422 preliminary suspected illicit drug overdose deaths in 2017, up 43% from 993 in 2016, with the rate rising to 30 deaths per 100,000 residents. Deaths declined in the final four months, including 103 in November and 99 in December. Approximately 81% of deaths involved fentanyl, and 64 involved carfentanil. Vancouver Coastal Health had the highest regional death rate, while Vancouver recorded the most deaths among townships. More than half of victims were aged 30–49, 90% were aged 19–59, about four-fifths were male, and nearly nine in ten deaths occurred indoors. No deaths occurred at supervised consumption or overdose prevention sites. Officials called the epidemic persistent and planned expanded naloxone distribution, drug-checking, outreach, treatment connections, and other strategies for 2018.
A Harvard Business School study found that several AI companions use emotional tactics to keep conversations from ending.

This study investigated mixed natural dyes from anthocyanin-rich mangosteen peel (MP) and chlorophyll-rich grass jelly leaves (GJL) as sensitizers for dye-sensitized solar cells. MP and GJL extracts were combined at volume ratios of 3:1, 2:1, 1:1, 1:2, and 1:3, then adsorbed onto TiO₂-coated ITO substrates and assembled with iodide/iodine electrolyte and graphite counter electrodes. UV–Vis spectroscopy showed that blending produced complementary absorption features and broadened light harvesting; increasing GJL content strengthened chlorophyll-related red absorption while weakening anthocyanin-related blue absorption. Microscopy and FESEM showed cracked, irregular MP-rich films, while mixed-dye photoanodes had more uniform, homogeneous nanoporous structures with well-adhered layers approximately 15–20 μm thick.

Under consistent halogen-lamp conditions, the 1:3 MP:GJL mixture produced the highest power conversion efficiency, 3.50 ± 0.19%, compared with 2.75 ± 0.31% for MP alone and 2.12 ± 0.46% for GJL alone. The 1:1 and 1:2 mixtures each achieved 2.93%, while 3:1 and 2:1 achieved 2.72% and 2.17%, respectively. The 1:3 device’s improved performance was associated with higher short-circuit current and stable open-circuit voltage, supporting enhanced light absorption and charge collection. During ten repeated cycles, GJL-rich mixtures retained more of their initial performance, whereas the 1:1 mixture declined rapidly; MP-dominant mixtures showed steadier, moderate decay. The authors identified photobleaching, dye desorption, and electrolyte–dye regeneration kinetics as relevant factors and recommended future work focused on long-term stability. Reported efficiencies were intended for relative comparison rather than direct comparison under the AM1.5G standard.

Luca Speight received the Outstanding Achievement Award and was named Isle of Wight College Student of the Year 2018. After returning from a life-threatening illness requiring hospitalization, surgery and an induced coma, he resumed catering studies, caught up on missed work, volunteered extensively and excelled in his placement.

Depoe Bay, Oregon, is preparing for the Aug. 21 total solar eclipse, the first to cross the continental United States in 99 years. Crowds are estimated at thousands to hundreds of thousands, and hotels and campgrounds are sold out. The city has ordered free protective glasses, added restrooms and trash cans, and advised residents to stock essentials. Extra firefighters will staff three stations as authorities work to prevent traffic blockages on Highway 101. The Coast Guard will monitor harbor traffic, while local operators have arranged fishing and offshore viewing trips.

The S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed at fresh records, aided by gains in AMD. Figma shares rose 7% Monday after briefly surging 16%, following OpenAI CEO Sam Altman’s demo of Figma integration within ChatGPT. The integration uses OpenAI’s Apps SDK, allowing users to request Figma assistance by name; monetization options and third-party app submissions are expected.

Traditional storage APIs can bottleneck modern games because faster NVMe SSDs require extensive CPU decompression. NVIDIA RTX IO, combined with Microsoft DirectStorage, keeps data compressed while transferring it from storage directly to an RTX GPU for GPU-based lossless decompression. This reduces CPU utilization, improves I/O performance, accelerates loading, raises frame rates, enables rapid asset streaming, and can reduce object pop-in and stutter. RTX IO also supports professional workloads involving large CAD, scientific, rendering, and virtual-reality datasets.

The GA10x-based NVIDIA A40 targets data-center visual computing, with up to twice the FP32 and ray-tracing throughput and up to five times the AI-training throughput of a Quadro RTX 6000, or ten times with sparsity. It provides PCIe Gen4 connectivity, 48 GB of memory scalable to 96 GB through NVLink, virtual-GPU support, and compatibility with the NVIDIA EGX Platform.

Ampere GPUs support 4K120 and 8K60 displays, DisplayPort 1.4a, HDMI 2.1 with 48 Gbps bandwidth, HDCP 2.3, and display stream compression. Their fifth-generation NVDEC decoder accelerates MPEG-2, VC-1, H.264, H.265, VP8, VP9, and AV1 decoding; AV1 playback can reach 8K60 HDR with low CPU usage. Seventh-generation NVENC provides hardware-accelerated encoding, including H.264 up to 4K and HEVC up to 8K, while freeing the graphics engine and CPU for other tasks.

The GA10x architecture provides up to twice the performance of the preceding generation in programmable shading, ray tracing, and AI. It includes second-generation RT Cores, third-generation Tensor Cores with structural sparsity, and support for GDDR6X memory. The RTX 3090 has 24 GB of GDDR6X, 10,496 CUDA cores, and up to 936 GB/s of peak memory bandwidth. The RTX 3070 uses GDDR6 and is described as faster than the previous-generation RTX 2080 Ti.

GDDR6X memory interfaces on GA10x GPUs include Error Detection and Replay, which detects failed transmissions and retries them. Memory errors during overclocking reduce effective bandwidth, creating a performance plateau that can indicate when to stop increasing clocks, although continued overclocking can still cause crashes.

The RTX A6000 includes 10,752 CUDA cores, second-generation RT Cores, 48 GB of GDDR6, and support for real-time and final-frame ray tracing, hardware-accelerated motion blur, and AI denoising. Two A6000 boards can be linked with NVLink for 96 GB of combined memory. NVIDIA’s specifications also cover generational rendering, HPC, and deep-learning performance comparisons with the RTX 6000.

Benjamin David Sherwood, a Wisconsin man who traveled to Houston seeking sex with a child he believed was 4, pleaded guilty to crossing state lines for illicit contact with a child and enticing a minor into sexual contact. He received 11 years in prison, lifelong supervision, sex-offender registration, and child and internet restrictions.

Microsoft Corporation’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2018 reported 7,683,197,503 common shares outstanding as of April 20, 2018.

- **Results:** For the three months, revenue was $26.819 billion versus $23.212 billion a year earlier, operating income was $8.292 billion versus $6.723 billion, net income was $7.424 billion versus $5.486 billion, and diluted EPS was $0.95 versus $0.70. For the nine months, revenue was $80.275 billion versus $70.966 billion, operating income was $24.679 billion versus $21.343 billion, net income was $7.698 billion versus $17.420 billion, and diluted EPS was $0.99 versus $2.22. Nine-month service and other revenue increased to $32.937 billion from $23.212 billion, while product revenue declined to $47.338 billion from $47.754 billion. The nine-month effective tax rate was 70% versus 21%, primarily due to a provisional net charge from the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

- **Financial position:** At March 31, 2018, total assets were $245.497 billion, total liabilities were $166.258 billion, and stockholders’ equity was $79.239 billion. Cash and cash equivalents totaled $9.221 billion and short-term investments totaled $123.049 billion. Long-term debt was $73.480 billion, with $3.447 billion classified as current and $230 million in short-term debt. Unearned revenue totaled $23.955 billion.

- **Cash flow:** For the nine months, Microsoft generated $32.466 billion from operations, used $3.391 billion in investing activities and $27.551 billion in financing activities, and increased cash by $1.558 billion to $9.221 billion. Capital expenditures were $7.652 billion, cash share repurchases were $8.359 billion, and cash dividends paid were $9.473 billion.

- **Accounting developments:** Microsoft adopted the lease standard on July 1, 2017, recognizing operating lease right-of-use assets and liabilities without affecting the income statements. It adopted the revenue standard using the full retrospective method, changing the timing of revenue recognition for Windows 10 licenses and certain multi-year commercial software subscriptions. This restated nine-month 2017 revenue from $66.633 billion to $70.966 billion and net income from $14.691 billion to $17.420 billion. The TCJA reduced the U.S. federal statutory rate from 35% to 21% and produced a provisional $13.8 billion net charge, including a $17.8 billion transition-tax charge, partly offset by tax-rate benefits. Accounting for the legislation remained subject to revision. Guidance not yet adopted included changes for intra-entity asset transfers and financial instruments effective July 1, 2018, hedging activities effective July 1, 2019, and credit losses effective July 1, 2020.

- **Revenue and balance-sheet disclosures:** Product revenue included operating systems, productivity and business applications, server applications, development tools, games, and hardware. Service and other revenue included Office 365, Azure, Dynamics 365, Xbox Live, support, consulting, advertising, and LinkedIn. Contracted revenue not yet recognized totaled $61 billion, of which approximately 60% was expected to be recognized within 12 months. Microsoft’s investment portfolio had $1.311 billion of unrealized losses at March 31, 2018, which management did not believe represented other-than-temporary impairments. Derivatives were used to manage foreign currency, equity-price, interest-rate, and credit risks.

- **Other matters:** The 2016 LinkedIn acquisition had a purchase price of $27.0 billion. Microsoft had $30.3 billion remaining under its $40 billion share-repurchase authorization and repurchased 78 million shares for $6.5 billion during the first nine months of fiscal 2018. Legal liabilities totaled $371 million, and Microsoft estimated that reasonably possible adverse outcomes could reach approximately $1.3 billion beyond recorded amounts. Contingencies included 34 other patent cases, Canadian antitrust class actions, a Chinese regulatory investigation, cellular-phone litigation, and an employment discrimination class action. Microsoft and IPCom settled all IPCom claims against Microsoft in April 2018.

Portland, second at 14-5-5, seeks to avenge last season’s 4-3 semifinal loss to Western New York, which became North Carolina, and has never lost to Orlando. Orlando returns Alex Morgan but will be without Camila, who tore her right ACL. North Carolina, 16-7-1, has never won the Shield and championship in the same season, while Chicago is led by Christen Press’s 11 goals. Lifetime began broadcasting weekly NWSL games, Sam Kerr won the Golden Boot with a record 17 goals, and Marta recorded 13 goals and six assists for Orlando.

BMW and Brilliance Automotive launched the China-only 1 Series sedan in July 2016. BMW is considering an Indian launch, which would compete with the Mercedes-Benz CLA and Audi A3. Derived from the 2015 BMW Concept Compact Sedan, the 4,456-mm-long car has a 2,670-mm wheelbase and uses the UKL1 platform. The front-wheel-drive model debuted in China with petrol engines; the 125i and 120i are considered likely candidates for India, where diesel options are also planned.

Forecast rain in the Feather River basin totals 7.5 inches over 10 days, well below the 13.6 inches that damaged Oroville Dam’s main spillway and nearly failed the emergency spillway. Colder temperatures and gradual rain should reduce runoff, though record snowpack poses a risk if warm weather arrives suddenly. The reservoir was 15 feet below the emergency spillway, and officials projected another 24-foot drop by Friday while upstream dams held back water.

The LSZ theorem relates scattering amplitudes to time-ordered correlation functions. Initial external momenta are assigned negative-energy roots and final momenta positive-energy roots before taking the on-shell limit. Scattering amplitudes are obtained from connected Feynman diagrams with external propagators removed; external-leg corrections are absorbed into a momentum-independent factor \(Z\), common to a given process and particle type, with \(Z=1\) at leading order. Correlation functions include these corrections, while scattering amplitudes do not.

The lecture then concludes its treatment of interacting theories and introduces fermions. The Klein–Gordon equation was an early relativistic wave equation but did not ensure positive-definite probability and allowed negative-energy states. Dirac sought a first-order, Lorentz-covariant equation using matrix-valued coefficients \(\alpha_i\) and \(\beta\). Requiring its square to reproduce the Klein–Gordon equation gives conditions including anticommutation, \(\alpha_i^2=1\), and \(\beta^2=1\). The smallest representation uses \(4\times4\) matrices and a four-component spinor.

Defining \(\gamma^0=i\beta\) and \(\gamma^i=i\beta\alpha^i\) yields the Dirac equation and the Clifford-algebra relation \(\{\gamma^\mu,\gamma^\nu\}=2\eta^{\mu\nu}\). Infinitely many representations exist, but all are related by similarity transformations and are physically equivalent; different forms can simplify calculations in different regimes. For a massless particle, two-component Pauli-matrix solutions suffice, whereas the massive case requires four components. The lecture also notes that a probability current can be derived classically. Lorentz covariance for the Dirac equation was not completed and was deferred to the next lecture.

Amazon.com, Inc.’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2017 reported net sales of $35.714 billion, up 23% from $29.128 billion a year earlier. Product sales were $23.734 billion and service sales were $11.980 billion. Operating income declined to $1.005 billion from $1.071 billion, while net income increased to $724 million from $513 million and diluted earnings per share rose to $1.48 from $1.07. The income tax provision fell to $229 million from $475 million, including $122 million of discrete benefits primarily from stock-based compensation.

North America generated $20.992 billion of sales, up 24%, and $596 million of operating income. International sales rose 16% to $11.061 billion, with an operating loss of $481 million. AWS sales increased 43% to $3.661 billion, and AWS operating income rose to $890 million. Management attributed North American and International growth primarily to increased unit sales, including third-party seller sales, lower prices, greater inventory availability and selection. AWS growth reflected increased customer usage and cost productivity, partly offset by pricing changes and higher infrastructure spending. Total operating expenses rose to $34.709 billion, and net shipping costs increased to $1.886 billion from $1.455 billion.

At March 31, 2017, Amazon held $15.440 billion of cash and cash equivalents and $6.091 billion of marketable securities. Trailing-twelve-month operating cash flow was $17.634 billion, investing activities used $10.798 billion, and reported free cash flow was $10.217 billion. Q1 cash capital expenditures were $1.861 billion. Total assets were $80.969 billion and stockholders’ equity was $21.674 billion. Total face-value debt was $8.827 billion; the $500 million secured revolving facility was fully drawn, while the $3 billion unsecured facility was unused. Contractual commitments totaled $45.939 billion, and purchase obligations and open purchase orders totaled $9.9 billion. Amazon signed a $580 million cash agreement to acquire Souq Group, subject to adjustments and customary closing conditions. A $5 billion stock-repurchase authorization remained, with no first-quarter repurchases.

Amazon adopted inventory accounting guidance without material impact and stock-based compensation guidance that increased retained earnings by $687 million. It retrospectively reclassified excess tax benefits of $207 million for Q1 2016 and $305 million for the trailing year from financing to operating cash flows. The company planned to adopt new revenue recognition guidance in Q1 2018, which could change revenue timing and gross presentation, and was evaluating pending lease, income-tax and restricted-cash guidance. Critical estimates included inventory recoverability; each additional 1% of inventory valuation allowance would have increased cost of sales by approximately $120 million.

The filing disclosed an ongoing review of orders involving persons and entities subject to Iran-related sanctions, which Amazon voluntarily reported to U.S. authorities and which could result in penalties. It also described European copyright tariff proceedings, patent litigation and other claims whose outcomes could be material. Tax contingencies totaled $1.8 billion and were expected to grow. The U.S. Tax Court largely adopted Amazon’s transfer-pricing approach for 2005 and 2006, although the decision was subject to appeal; an IRS loss or similar adjustments in later years could result in approximately $1.5 billion of additional federal tax. Amazon was also contesting a €196 million French tax assessment.

For Q2 2017, Amazon guided to net sales of $35.25 billion to $37.75 billion, representing 16% to 24% growth, including an anticipated $720 million foreign-exchange headwind, and operating income of $425 million to $1.075 billion. The company remained exposed to interest-rate, foreign-currency and investment-value changes. International represented 31% of consolidated sales, and a 5%, 10% or 20% adverse currency movement on $6.8 billion of foreign funds would reduce fair value by approximately $340 million, $680 million or $1.4 billion, respectively.

Phuket Governor Norraphat Plodthong ordered lifeguards to resume patrolling local beaches by April 1, 2018, following a March 21 meeting with provincial officials. Local administrative offices were told to cover beaches in Muang Phuket and Kathu districts, while a company selected through procurement would serve Thalang district. Previously, the Phuket Provincial Administration Organisation deployed 37 lifeguards at 15 points across six beaches from December 28 to February 26. Local authorities without six-month funding from April were told to seek PPAO support, while next year’s lifeguard budgets would come from local administrations. This financial-support instruction appeared to conflict with the governor’s earlier December 12 order that the PPAO would no longer be involved in lifeguard provision.

Schmidt Sciences, founded by former Google CEO Eric Schmidt and Wendy Schmidt, will spend $45 million over five years on carbon-cycle research, including deploying four uncrewed surface vessels in the Southern Ocean. The remotely piloted boats will collect data in difficult-to-reach waters beyond shipping routes, including during winter, and measure seawater CO2 partial pressure. Machine learning will guide their routes, and the data will be publicly available.

The project addresses limited observations, extreme weather, cloud cover, and inconsistent climate models concerning the Southern Ocean’s role as a major carbon sink. Under a public-private partnership, Schmidt Sciences will buy data from vessel operators contracted through NOAA, which supports co-lead scientist Galen McKinley. The initiative is especially timely because proposed federal budget cuts would sharply reduce NOAA and National Science Foundation research funding, increasing reliance on private support.

The passage documents stackless, register-passing AGESA procedures for host environments. `AMD_ENABLE_STACK` divides the pre-memory stack region among processor cores, maps it into global address space, configures processor MTRRs, and creates a `UEFI_SEC_PEI_HAND_OFF` structure in the stack frame. It must run on all cores. In protected mode, SS is unchanged and must reference a zero-base GDT descriptor; in real mode, SS:ESP uses 16-bit segment:offset form. AARCH64 systems with a PSP do not use this stack and instead rely on the PSP to initialize DRAM. The procedure can warn that a previous stack is being reset or fatally fail for an unknown processor family.

A corresponding stack-removal procedure is run only by the BSP after memory becomes available and the stack and MTRR map have been relocated or synchronized. It disables CAR mode, flushes all cache lines, and leaves the BSP’s cache enabled with its contents invalidated without write-back.

`AmdCreateStruct` allocates and initializes AGESA parameter structures using `PreMemHeap`, `PostMemDram`, or host-provided storage. With host allocation, the host must ensure sufficient space and use `StdHeader` as the storage base. Structures must later be released through `AmdReleaseStruct`.

Other services require an established stack and, where specified, operational coherent HyperTransport links. They provide DIMM read/write data-eye bitmaps for all byte lanes, APIC addresses by socket and core, pre-memory execution-cache capacity for the current core, and base PCI addresses by socket and die, with function and register fields set to zero. Additional procedures identify the current socket, die, and core and map a memory address to its socket, channel, DIMM, chip select, bank, row, and column, supporting FRU identification and detailed memory-error location.

Scientists have identified a possible clue to the origin of will-o’-the-wisps: tiny electrical discharges from crowded air bubbles in water. Researchers led by Yu Xia designed a 3-D-printed nozzle to produce microbubbles and used photon counters and high-speed cameras to detect faint flashes. Air bubbles produced microlightning, while adding methane increased photon emissions and heated the water. Making the bubbles smaller and closer together produced visible sparks, suggesting electron transfers between bubbles of opposite charge. These sparks might ignite methane seeping from swamps and create blue-flamed will-o’-the-wisps, but researchers caution that underwater laboratory conditions do not fully explain flames hovering in air. The findings may advance triboelectricity research and support greener chemical reactions, pollutant transformation and gas breakdown.

In daisy-chain topology, the host supplies shared CONVST/CS and SCLK, and each device's SDO-0 feeds the next device's SDI, with the last returning to the host. Identical configuration registers are programmed (SDO_CTL_REG bits 7-0 = 00h). Data shifts MSB-first, device N first; an optimal frame has 32 × N SCLK capture edges.

During Prime Day, Solawave’s 4-in-1 Renewal Wand costs a little over $100. It targets specific areas, vibrates and warms for massage-like use, and requires three minutes of manual application versus about 10 for a typical face mask. Testers reported skin tightening, especially around the eyes. It uses a single 630-nm wavelength; a face mask is also discounted to $227.

On February 10, 2016, Amazon.com, Inc.’s Board elected Wendell P. Weeks as a director and appointed him to its Audit Committee. Weeks received 1,365 restricted stock units vesting in three equal annual installments beginning February 15, 2017, subject to continued service, and entered into an indemnification agreement with Amazon. Russ Grandinetti will assume responsibility for Amazon’s international consumer business, reporting to Jeffrey A. Wilke.
